description: This file contains utility functions, classes, and decorators related to type promotion, dtype conversion, output resizing, device checks, and autograd handling for PyTorch primitives, specifically within the _prims_common module.

classes.name: elementwise_type_promotion_wrapper
classes.description: A class that adds elementwise type promotion behavior to functions, handling argument type promotion and result dtype coercion based on specified rules.

methods.name: _maybe_convert_to_dtype
methods.description: Converts input to specified dtype if necessary, supporting TensorLike, Number, and Sequence types.

methods.name: _maybe_convert_to_type
methods.description: Safely casts a scalar Number to a specified type, ensuring type safety.

methods.name: _annotation_has_type
methods.description: Checks if a given annotation has a specific type within its __args__.

methods.name: elementwise_type_promotion_wrapper.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the wrapper with specified type promotion kind and argument names.

methods.name: elementwise_type_promotion_wrapper.__call__
methods.description: Wraps a function to add elementwise type promotion behavior, including dtype inference and conversion.

methods.name: _resize_output_check
methods.description: Checks if the output tensor shape matches the expected shape, issuing a warning if resizing is needed.

methods.name: _maybe_resize_out
methods.description: Resizes the output tensor if shape mismatch is detected.

methods.name: is_cpu_scalar
methods.description: Checks if a tensor is a CPU scalar (0-dimensional tensor on CPU).

methods.name: check_copy_devices
methods.description: Ensures source and destination tensors are on the same device before copying.

methods.name: _safe_copy_out
methods.description: Copies data from one tensor to another with device and dtype safety checks.

methods.name: out_wrapper
methods.description: Decorator that manages 'out' parameters for functions, handling in-place updates and shape/dtype consistency.

methods.name: backwards_not_supported
methods.description: Wraps a primitive to disable autograd backward pass, raising an error if backward is attempted.

methods.name: elementwise_unary_scalar_wrapper
methods.description: Wraps unary functions to support Python scalar inputs by converting them to tensors.
